d:
AIMIM ke rashtriy adhyaksh asduddin auvaisi ki parti ke bihar pradesh adhyaksh aur amaur vidhayak akhtarul eeman ka ek vidiyo vayral ho raha jismen vah dulhan ki tulna tavayaph se karte dikh rahe hain. vidiyo men unhonne muslim samaj men shadi ke dauran dulhan ki munh dikhaee, valima men uphar lene aur phijulkharchi jaisi paranpraon par saval uthae. unhonne shariyat, saman nagrik sanhita aur musalmanon ki suraksha ko lekar bhi bayan diya.
